title: Alarm priority on Wear OS 3.0 / Galaxy watch 4
body:
### Subject of the issue
On Wear OS 2.0 xDrip alarms made my watch vibrate intensively 3 times. On Wear OS 3.0 on the Galaxy watch 4 the watch vibrates like for ordinary notifications. The problem is that I may not notice the alarm. 
I don’t know if this is a bug or if it is simply not possible to make high-priority notifications on Wears OS 3.0.

### Your environment
- xDrip version: Nightly build 2nd Sep 2021
- The option to use the Android notification channels is used.

### Expected behavior
An intense vibration when having an alarm.

### Actual behavior
A slight vibration like for every other notification.
